title: DERBY01
back: Two to eight cars, four seats each: a driver, two gunners firing paint from the turrets, and a mechanic.
Every seat plays by touch, keys, mouse or gamepad, and the computer takes the seats nobody sits in.
Each car drives its own way, stock, rally, drift, sport or muscle, with nitro for a burst of speed.
Score with damage, wrecks, held drifts and the radar shot off a roof, while the mechanic fixes what breaks.
Each map number lays out its own town, three blocks each way round an open square, sized to the number of cars.
